unverified.rod_length_in: 5.875 in - NHRA AMER-66..69 and Super Stock & Drag Illustrated Aug 1972 (AHPS repeats SS&DI text verbatim, counted once). Only 2 independent sources.
unverified.firing_order: 1-8-4-3-6-5-7-2 is the commonly cited AMC Gen 2/3 V8 order, but no reputable source found stating it for the 290 (only offroaders.com / parts pages for 304/360).
unverified.block_material: Cast iron (thinwall) expected - SS&DI 1972 says blocks are 'thinwall castings', cranks/rods nodular iron; Wikipedia says 'thin-wall' casting but not the metal. Fewer than 3 sources state cast iron.
unverified.head_material: Cast iron expected; no source found explicitly stating it for the 290.
